description: A free cosmetic unlocked by tuning into the LoveTropics 48-hour Minecraft charity livestream, raising funds for the Pachamama Alliance — an organization dedicated to protecting the world's rainforests and the indigenous cultures within them. Awarded alongside the Creeper Floaty to all viewers during the event.
notes: Released as part of the LoveTropics charity event on November 21, 2025. Donors of $10 or more also received the exclusive Pogfish pet.
